newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland cuts 3-yr floating bond min price to 98.90.
newsitem.headline: Poland cuts 3-yr floating bond min price to 98.90.

text.p: The Polish Treasury sold 27 million zlotys of its three-year index-linked bonds after investors bid for 358 million worth of the bonds at the 700 million zloty primary tender, the finance ministry said.
The minimum accepted price was 98.90, down from 100.00 at the last auction of similar bonds on October 22, 1996.
The average price also fell to 99.42 from 100.37.
